item.title: Show HN: Turn an idea into a product you can order
item.summary: We are launching Luphra. Describe what you want. Generate it in 3D. Customize it. Turn it into something real. We are starting with 3D printables, but our vision is much bigger: prompting physical products into existence. Let me know what you guys think!
